'''Veor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a weapons vendor located in the [[Concourse Bazaar]] of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veor was originally planned to be an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]], but was later changed to a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]].
